correctness.rationale: Marked-cycle deletion yields both expected counts, their mixed moment, and the normalized ratio for all feasible fixed color populations. Each rational factor of G decreases strictly in theta, giving the complete sign classification; exact positivity at theta down zero and limit at infinity give a unique balanced root. Exact series yields theta_m=m/4+5/4+O(1/m), and first-order mean/ratio expansions prove the signed n-scale covariance. The companion code exhaustively checks 41040 permutations at four exact rational weights and 622 recorded test conditions.
